_comment: Hand-written: iconic item per first-level area, keyed by the geoBoundaries ADM1 shapeName, and optional hand-picked district items keyed by the ADM2 shapeName. tools/build_countries.py merges this into data/countries/SGP.json.

CENTRAL REGION.lore: The Merlion spouts water at Marina Bay, below the city skyline.

EAST REGION.lore: Changi Airport, one of the busiest hubs in Asia, and East Coast Park.

NORTH REGION.lore: Mandai: Singapore Zoo and the rainforest parks around it; the causeway starts at Woodlands.

NORTH-EAST REGION.lore: Bumboats cross to Pulau Ubin, the island village that still looks like old Singapore.

WEST REGION.lore: Jurong: the Jurong Lake District, industry on Jurong Island and the country's universities.

DOWNTOWN CORE.note: The Merlion spouts water into Marina Bay at Merlion Park.

MARINA SOUTH.note: The Supertree Grove of Gardens by the Bay.

SOUTHERN ISLANDS.note: Sentosa and the other islands south of the city.

CHANGI.note: Changi Airport and its Jewel waterfall; the old Changi Village is at the island's east tip.
